Execution Coordination & Oversight Provides operational oversight across multiple studies or therapeutic areas. Maintain study documentation, trackers, and operational tools to ensure consistent process application. Coordinate safety requests, data requests, timelines, and other cross-functional operational needs. Requirements Training and Education Preferred: PhD in Epidemiology preferred, Master's degree required (MPH minimum). Prior Experience Preferred Experience in applied epidemiology or scientific operations. Experience in the field of vaccines and/or infectious diseases strongly preferred. Be part of a forward-thinking team that helps shape the next generation of evidence-based healthcare. Work hand-in-hand with one leading sponsor, gaining deep expertise in their therapies.
